hpe_rgba.brief: 用四个通道分量构造颜色 / Build a colour from four channel components

params.r: 红色通道（0~255）/ Red channel, 0 to 255
params.g: 绿色通道（0~255）/ Green channel, 0 to 255
params.b: 蓝色通道（0~255）/ Blue channel, 0 to 255
params.a: 不透明度通道（0 全透明，255 全不透明）/ Alpha channel, 0 fully transparent to 255 fully opaque

hpe_rgba.return: 构造出的颜色 / The constructed colour
hpe_rgba.note: 不做范围校验，超出 0~255 的值按 uint8_t 回绕 / Values outside 0 to 255 are not validated and wrap around as `uint8_t`

hpe_rgb.brief: 用红绿蓝三分量构造不透明颜色 / Build an opaque colour from red, green and blue

params.r: 红色通道（0~255）/ Red channel, 0 to 255
params.g: 绿色通道（0~255）/ Green channel, 0 to 255
params.b: 蓝色通道（0~255）/ Blue channel, 0 to 255

hpe_rgb.return: alpha 固定为 255 的颜色 / The colour with alpha fixed at 255
hpe_rgb.note: 等价于 `hpe_rgba(r, g, b, 255)` / Equivalent to `hpe_rgba(r, g, b, 255)`

hpe_rect.brief: 用左上角坐标与宽高构造矩形 / Build a rectangle from its top-left corner and size

params.x: 左边界 X 坐标 / Left edge X coordinate
params.y: 上边界 Y 坐标 / Top edge Y coordinate
params.w: 宽度，可正可负 / Width, may be negative
params.h: 高度，可正可负 / Height, may be negative

hpe_rect.return: 构造出的矩形 / The constructed rectangle
hpe_rect.note: 输入不做规范化，负宽高会原样保留 / Inputs are not normalised, negative widths and heights are kept as given

hpe_rect_empty.brief: 判断矩形是否为空 / Test whether a rectangle is empty

params.r: 待检查的矩形，按值传入 / Rectangle to inspect, passed by value

hpe_rect_empty.return: 宽或高小于等于 0 返回 1 / 1 when the width or the height is not positive
hpe_rect_empty.note: 空矩形不覆盖任何像素，光栅化阶段会直接跳过 / An empty rectangle covers no pixel and is skipped by the rasteriser
